options: Walk me through what happens when a token arrives.
What would make this API accept a token it shouldn't?

answers.a: The request hits the JWT bearer handler. It checks issuer, lifetime and signing key — but Program.cs line 8 sets ValidateAudience = false, so a token issued for another API would pass. I'd set ValidateAudience = true and ValidAudience = "shop-api", and add a negative test: a foreign-audience token returns 401.
answers.b: The agent handled authentication — I can ask it to check.
